title: Is steerability of a safety concept correlated with how cleanly a probe detects it?

original_idea.body: Across ~8 concepts compute linear probe AUC and steering efficacy at a fixed coefficient on the same model/layer, plot detectability vs steerability, and quantify the correlation with outliers highlighted.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: detectability-predicts-steerability tests a load-bearing assumption, but link skips a step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Probe AUC vs steering correlation; single model, no training, ideal beginner scope.

novelty.reasoning: Overlaps gen-1368; read/write correlation may be partly open.
